Show this invoice to your manager.

legacy-dispatch-uncertainty.body: A payment started by an earlier version of the app was cancelled. It may have requested a stock reservation; that cannot be verified. No sale was recorded. This stays open for review and cannot be closed from the workstation.

allocation-request-pending.title: Stock reservation request awaiting the server's answer
allocation-request-pending.body: The answer to this request was not received. It will be confirmed automatically; until then it is not treated as granted or refused.

refunds.stockReturnedHint: A line sold as a service is never affected by this choice, even when the product is tracked today.
refunds.referenceHint: The terminal or authorisation reference for this refund, if any.
refunds.recordedNotice: This refund will be recorded on the sale. It does not itself move money on a card or wallet.
refunds.successDetail: Refund {number} was recorded for this sale.
refunds.feasibilityBlockedNotice: This line cannot be refunded through this screen because its refund history is inconsistent. It is not selectable, and it was never silently left out of the totals above.
refunds.capabilityUnavailable: Refunds are not available for this sale on this connection.
refunds.capabilityUnavailableDetail: This backend does not yet support the confirmed-refund contract this app requires, so no refund is offered here.
refunds.noRefundableQuantity: There is nothing left to refund on this sale.
refunds.invoiceNotSynced: This sale hasn't synced yet. It can't be refunded until it has.
refunds.offlineNotice: Refunds need a connection. Reconnect to return items.
refunds.shiftRequired: An open shift is required to start a new refund.
refunds.permissionRequired: You do not have permission to issue refunds.
refunds.alreadyOpen: A refund is already in progress for this sale.
refunds.pendingUnresolved: This refund's outcome is unknown. Resume it to find out, or leave it -- it still blocks a new refund on this sale until it is resolved.
refunds.conflictNotice: This refund's record conflicted with the server. It is unknown whether money moved. This sale stays blocked for a new refund; contact support with the reference below.
refunds.staleNotice: The reviewed amount changed before it could be submitted. Review the refund again.
refunds.zeroAmountNotice: There is no money to refund for this selection.

errors.refund_invoice_not_found: This sale could not be found on this workstation.
errors.refund_invoice_not_synced: This sale hasn't synced yet. It can't be refunded until it has.
errors.refund_line_not_found: One or more selected lines could not be found on this invoice.
errors.refund_line_infeasible: One or more selected lines cannot be refunded because of an inconsistent refund history.
errors.refund_no_lines_selected: Select at least one item to refund.
errors.refund_amount_zero_not_postable: There is no money to refund for this selection.
errors.refund_preview_not_found: This refund preview is no longer available. Review the refund again.
errors.refund_preview_stale: The refund selection changed since it was reviewed. Review it again.
errors.refund_already_open: A refund is already in progress for this sale.
errors.refund_not_found: This refund could not be found.
errors.refund_not_resumable: This refund is not in a state that can be resumed.
errors.refund_dispatch_failed: This refund could not be dispatched.
errors.refund_payment_method_unavailable: The selected refund method is not available.
errors.refund_payment_method_unsupported: This payment method cannot be used for a refund.
errors.refund_calculation_stale: The confirmed refund amount changed before it could be submitted. Review it again.
errors.refund_confirmation_required: This connection does not support the confirmed-refund contract required for this refund.
errors.refund_contract_version_unsupported: This connection's refund contract version is not supported by this app.
errors.line_refund_infeasible_historically: This line's refund history is inconsistent and cannot be refunded here.
errors.original_sale_stock_effect_indeterminate: The original sale's stock effect could not be determined. This refund needs a manager or inventory check before it can proceed.

refunds.notToStock: Items do not return to stock
refunds.reasonPlaceholder: For example: customer returned an unopened item
refunds.submittingHint: Keep this window open. Do not start another refund for this sale.

printing.previewUnavailable: The preview could not be prepared.
printing.reprintNotice: This receipt was already sent to the printer. This copy is marked Reprint.
printing.autoPrintDescription: Prints once per sale. You can always print or reprint manually.
printing.settingsDescription: Choose the printer, paper width and printing behaviour for this workstation.

status.submitted: Sent to the printer. Check that the whole receipt came out.
status.failed_before_dispatch: Couldn't print. Nothing was sent to the printer.
status.outcome_unknown: Can't confirm what printed. Check the paper before printing again. Another print may duplicate it and will be marked Reprint.

errors.previewStale: The receipt changed since it was last previewed. Review it again before printing.

printing.submittedHint: The app cannot see the paper; please look at the printer.

signOut.title: Sign out of this workstation?
signOut.body: You will need a connection to sign in again.
signOut.queue: {count} sales are still waiting to upload. They stay saved on this workstation and upload after the next sign in.
signOut.failed: Sign out did not complete. Try again.

notices.offlineBody: You can keep selling — sales upload when the connection returns.
notices.unreachableBody: You can keep selling. We will keep trying in the background.
notices.pausedBody: Sales are saved on this workstation and will upload when syncing resumes.
notices.reviewBody: Selling is not affected. Check them with your manager.

receiptProfile.title: Company receipt profile
receiptProfile.description: The logo, address and footer printed on receipts at every workstation in your company.
receiptProfile.offlineNotice: You are offline. Changing the receipt profile needs a connection.
receiptProfile.conflictReloaded: Someone else saved the receipt profile first. Their version is now loaded. Review it and make your changes again.
receiptProfile.yourChanges: Your changes that were not saved
receiptProfile.previewEmpty: No header or footer lines yet.
receiptProfile.previewNote: A preview of the header and footer only. Printed receipts stay white in both themes.
